transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I’m having trouble keeping my head on things. At work I’ll be doing inventory and forget what I was counting, or I’ll go to the supply closet and just blank on why I’m there. I’ve been trying to study for a supervisor certification too, but I keep reading the same line over and over. It’s been getting hard to get through normal stuff.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy, like hobbies or activities?
I don’t know… I haven’t really thought about it that way. I still do some things, I guess. Nothing really stands out.
How long have you been having trouble with your memory or concentration?
About three years, I think. It started after they moved us onto those rotating evening and overnight shifts at the bigger properties.
Do you find yourself getting easily distracted, fidgety, or having trouble staying focused on tasks, even outside of work or studying?

Yeah… mostly the staying focused part. I’ll be in the middle of inventory and lose track, or go to the supply closet and forget what I went for. Same with studying—I'll keep reading the same line and it just doesn’t stick.
Do you find yourself struggling with staying organized, keeping track of tasks, or putting things off until the last minute?

Yeah… keeping track of things is hard. I’ll be doing inventory and lose my place, or go to the supply closet and just… forget what I went in there for. Studying’s been the same. I read the same line over and over and it doesn’t really stick.
Do you have similar problems with concentration and forgetfulness in other places, like at home or when you’re out running errands, or is it mostly at work?

It’s not just work. At home, if I’m trying to study for that supervisor certification, I’ll read the same line over and over and it just doesn’t stay. Errands… sometimes I’ll forget what I was going to grab. But I notice it most with inventory and the supply closet stuff.
Do you also have trouble concentrating or remembering things during social activities, conversations, or other situations outside of work and studying?
A little, yeah. In conversations I can drift off and miss pieces, but… it’s more noticeable when I’m trying to do inventory or study. My head just doesn’t stay on task like it used to.
Looking back, did you have trouble focusing or staying on task when you were a child, like in school or during activities, or is this something that mostly started for you as an adult?

I don’t really remember it being like this as a kid. I mean, maybe normal stuff, but… this feels more like now. I came in because my head just doesn’t stay on task anymore—inventory, studying for the supervisor certification, forgetting what I went to the supply closet for. That kind of thing.
Outside of work and studying, do you also notice these concentration or forgetfulness issues during everyday tasks at home or during social interactions?

Yeah… some, but it’s mostly when I’m trying to focus on a task. Like inventory, or studying for that supervisor certification—I’ll read the same line over and over. Or I’ll go to the supply closet and forget what I went in there for. At home or talking to people, it happens a little, but I notice it more with that kind of stuff.

Can you think of any situations outside of work and studying—like at home, with family, or during social activities—where you’ve had to really struggle to stay focused or remember what you were doing?

I mean… outside of that, not as much. It’s mostly when I’m trying to do something that needs focus. Like I’ll go to the supply closet and then just blank on why I went there, or I’ll be reading for that certification and keep hitting the same line over and over. At home it happens some, but that’s the kind of thing I notice.

Can you remember a time when you had trouble staying focused or forgot what you were doing during a family event, while having a conversation, or doing something casual at home—like watching TV or cooking, for example?

Not really a clear example like that. It’s more… when I’m trying to do something that takes focus. Like inventory, or studying for the supervisor test—I’ll keep reading the same line and not take it in. Or I’ll walk to the supply closet and forget what I went there for.

Have you noticed these focus or forgetfulness issues in situations that aren’t related to work or studying—like when you’re at home relaxing, talking with friends, or doing something that should be simple like following a recipe or keeping track of a conversation?

A little, maybe, but I notice it more when there’s some task I’m trying to get through. Like inventory, or studying for the supervisor certification—I’ll just keep reading the same line and not really take it in. Or I’ll go to the supply closet and forget what I needed. At home… I don’t know, nothing as clear as that.
Can you tell me if you’ve noticed any trouble staying focused or forgetting things when you’re just relaxing at home, watching TV, or doing something casual like that?

Not so much when I’m just watching TV or relaxing. It’s more when I’m trying to get something done, like inventory or studying for that supervisor certification. My head just doesn’t stay on it… I’ll read the same line over, or go to the supply closet and forget what I was there for.
Can you tell me if you’ve had trouble staying focused or found yourself forgetting things even when you’re doing something casual, like watching TV, talking with friends, or just relaxing at home?

Not really in those casual moments, no. It’s more when I’m trying to get something done. Like inventory, or studying for that supervisor certification… I’ll read the same line over and over, or I’ll go to the supply closet and forget what I went in there for.

Have you noticed any difficulty focusing or forgetfulness when you’re not actively working or studying—like when you’re just at home relaxing, talking with friends, or doing something simple like following a recipe or watching TV?

Not really when I’m just relaxing or watching TV. It’s more when I’m trying to get something done—inventory, or studying for that supervisor certification. My head just kind of slips off it, and I’ll read the same line again and again, or forget why I went to the supply closet.

Can you think of any times when you’ve had trouble focusing or forgotten what you were doing while doing something simple at home, like following a conversation, cooking a meal, or getting ready for the day?

Not really with cooking or talking, I guess. It’s more when I’m trying to do something that takes focus… like inventory, or studying for that supervisor certification. I’ll keep reading the same line, or I’ll go to the supply closet and then just blank on why I went there.
Have you ever had trouble focusing or forgotten what you were doing while having a conversation, driving, or doing something that doesn't require much effort?

Not so much with conversations or driving. It’s more when I’m trying to stay on a task, like inventory or studying for that supervisor certification. I’ll read the same line a bunch of times, or go to the supply closet and forget what I went there for.

Can you tell me if you’ve had trouble focusing or forgetting things even during simple daily routines—like remembering where you put your keys, following directions while driving, or keeping track of what day it is?

Not really with stuff like what day it is or driving directions. It’s more when I’m trying to stay on a task. Like inventory, or studying for that supervisor certification… I’ll keep reading the same line, or I’ll go to the supply closet and forget what I went for.

Can you think of any times outside of work and studying—like at home, with family, or during social events—where you had real trouble staying focused or forgot what you were doing, even during simple or casual activities?

Not really outside of that, no. I mean… it’s mostly when I have to stay with something, like inventory or studying for that supervisor thing. My head just kind of slips off it, and I’ll reread the same line or forget why I went to the supply closet. At home or with family, I haven’t noticed it as much.
Can you tell me if you’ve ever had trouble staying focused or forgetting things while doing everyday activities like talking on the phone, watching TV, or reading for fun?

Not really with phone calls or TV. Reading, maybe if it’s for that supervisor certification… I’ll keep going over the same line. Mostly it’s when I’m doing inventory or something at work, and I lose track of what I was doing, like going to the supply closet and forgetting why.
